    Queue item: add, update, measure¶

    Living document, last changed 2026-11-03 at a7af645d1.

    The queue is one manifest for every programme. state is a claim about what the gates will say; make queue-status is the measurement. queue/README.md is the full field reference; this skill is the procedure.

    1. Before editing¶

    git status --short queue/work-queue.yaml     # ' M' before your edit = a peer's uncommitted work; ask them to commit first
grep -n "^  - id: <ID>" queue/work-queue.yaml   # does the item already exist?
grep -n "register: \[.*BF-<n>" queue/work-queue.yaml  # is the register id already covered by another item?

    An id may be covered by cross-reference (add it to an existing item's register: list) when that item already tracks it in substance. Do not create a duplicate item, and do not touch anything else on an item another session owns.

    2. Write the item¶

    Append to items:. Every field below is required unless marked optional.

      - id: BFQ-227                           # unique; validate enforces it
    title: "bf/example - one line"        # QUOTE it when it contains '#'
    parcel: register-open                 # must exist in the parcels: block
    repo: cgm-remote-monitor
    branch: bf/example
    base: official/dev@61eb3733           # WHICH commit, never just "dev"
    worktree: externals/work/crm-bf-example
    state: gate-not-met                   # a claim; see states: in meta
    blast_radius: 2 commits, lib/server/example.js, +40/-12.
    review: maintainer, plus one reviewer who has not merged their own work here
    operator_visible: >
      Plain language for people managing diabetes. Empty string if an operator sees nothing.
    semver: patch                         # patch | minor | major | n/a
    semver_reason: >
      Why. Name the surface that moves.
    ships_to_operators_today: true        # register items only: register §1 = true, §1b = false
    register: [BF-227]
    gates:
      - run: node tools/queue/gates/example-gate.js
        kind: static                      # static | unit | integration | network
        describe: what this proves, in one line
      - no-gate: >
          Why no instrument exists and what building one would take.
    blocks_on: []                         # ids in this file; cycles are rejected
    evidence:
      - docs/60-research/remedial/example-2026-11-03.md
    notes: >
      Anything a reader needs that is not a field.

    YAML traps the validator cannot see: a space then # in an unquoted value starts a comment and silently truncates the value; no becomes False; 1.20 becomes 1.2; a repeated key keeps the last. Quote prose or use > block scalars. make queue-fidelity measures truncation.

    3. Write the gate so that it can fail¶

    A gate is a command that exits non-zero when the property does not hold. There is no third shape besides run: and no-gate:.

    1. Scripts go in tools/queue/gates/, Node, read-only: git show/git archive into scratch, never git checkout into a worktree. _gate.js gives show(ref, file), git(args), report(name, findings); report exits non-zero on any bad finding and on zero findings.
    2. Break it before you trust it. Revert or damage the property, run the gate, confirm red with the expected symptom, restore. A green ablation means either the gate is vacuous or the break broke nothing; say which.
    3. Declare the control in queue/gate-controls.yaml, keyed by the gate's exact command text: control: (same instrument on a known-false state, must exit non-zero) or control-exempt: with a reason. Optional positive-control: must exit zero. Editing the command text orphans the control on purpose; re-author it.

    4. Run the checks¶

    make queue-validate                 # schema, ids, blocks_on, gate rule, fidelity
make queue                          # regenerate QUEUE.md (never hand-edit it)
make queue-status ID="BFQ-227"      # run this item's gates; read the verdict words
make queue-vacuity                  # the control must report NON-VACUOUS for your gate
make queue-check                    # register coverage, every generated view current, links

    Verdicts: PASS, FAIL (measured negative), NO-INSTRUMENT (script missing), UNMEASURED (nothing ran). Only PASS is green. Integration and network gates run only with INTEGRATION=1 or --network and the runner says when it skipped them.

    Run the checks after git add: the link and staleness gates read git ls-files and cannot see an untracked file.

    5. Commit¶

    Generated views (queue/QUEUE.md, the overview blocks, reports/reviewer-packets/) are shared. Regenerate them, check git diff --cached --name-only for a peer's paths, and commit by path:

    git commit -- queue/work-queue.yaml queue/QUEUE.md queue/gate-controls.yaml \
  tools/queue/gates/example-gate.js docs/00-overview reports/reviewer-packets

    Say in the message if the regenerated views carry another session's items. No trailers.
